messages:
Claire (partnerships): Quick sync — Halcyon asked us to co-run a short perf/W + throughput benchmark for the marketplace listing. They want a reproducible run, kernel tuning notes, and a short writeup by next Wed. Can we agree on matrix + owners? cc: @halcyon-ops
Diego (eng-ml): I can own the model side. Proposal: run 3 sequence lengths (512/2048/8192), batch sizes [1,4,8], and power caps [default, -10%, -20%] on their A100-ish board. Measure tokens/sec, p50/p95 latency, and watts (IPA/raft meter). Keep quant and hf model fixed (we'll use quantized 4-bit variant).
Jin (eng-platform): Sounds good. For kernel tuning we should test two kernel builds: stock cuDNN+our runtime vs our tuned kernels (kernel-v3). I can prepare the patched runtime image. Need to know OS/hypervisor from Halcyon.
Maria (eng-sre): I'll book the Redwood lab slot for Tue/Wed next week and reserve the PDUs. Also will set up Prom + node-exporter and a power meter collector. Who can add the perf markers we use for trace correlation? (we need prefix cache markers)
Diego (eng-ml): I'll add the perf markers and the eval prompts. Quick runbook snippet I propose to commit to the repo:

```
# run single config
./run_bench --model redwood/opt-4bit --seq 2048 --batch 4 --kernel kernel-v3 \
  --powercap -10 --samples 200 --telemetry-url http://prom:9091/push
```

Output to capture: tokens/s, p50, p95, GPU power (W), CPU power, and kv-cache hit ratio.
Jin (eng-platform): For reproducibility, we'll containerize everything. I'll push image tag: redwood/bench:halcyon-2026-03-01. Also need the Halcyon board firmware version and driver; ask Halcyon to deploy the driver recommended for kernel-v3.
Claire (partnerships): I'll ping Halcyon for firmware/driver and request a short SOC spec sheet. Can someone draft the public blurb for marketplace? We want to avoid detailed numbers in the initial blurb — maybe show relative efficiency (e.g., "~1.9x perf/W vs baseline") and link to the full report.
Diego (eng-ml): Draft blurb: "Joint benchmark with Halcyon HW shows ~1.8-2.1x perf/W improvements on typical LLM workloads after kernel tuning and runtime optimizations. Full reproducible benchmark and tuning notes in the public repo." I'll post a PR after runs.
Maria (eng-sre): bench-bot scheduled a 3-hour reserved window: Tue 09:00-12:00. If we need more, say now.
bench-bot: Reservation confirmed — lab-3 reserved Tue 09:00-12:00 (ID: res-8821). Telemetry collector endpoint: http://lab3-telemetry.internal:9091
Jin (eng-platform): One more: we should capture pre/post kernel microbench numbers (matmul GEMM throughput, attention kernel latencies). Small script to run before the LLM runs:

```
# microbench
./microbench --kernel kernel-v3 --gflops --repeat 50 > microbench-kernel-v3.log
```

This helps attribute regressed perf to a specific kernel change.
Claire (partnerships): Great. Action items:
- Claire: ask Halcyon for firmware + SOC spec + confirm they can mirror image (today)
- Diego: prepare model prompts, perf markers, and PR for runbook (EOD Mon)
- Jin: build and publish bench image + kernel-v3 runtime (EOD Mon)
- Maria: finalize lab booking, telemetry & power meter config (today)
- bench-bot: reserve artifacts storage and post-run upload URL
Diego (eng-ml): One ask — can we record power from both GPU board sensor and external PDU? Halcyon sometimes reports board sensors optimistic. External PDU is authoritative.
Maria (eng-sre): Yes, we'll capture both and mark source in telemetry. Also enabling per-process sampling to correlate tokens/s with power.
Claire (partnerships): I'll propose a short standing call Tue 08:30 for a pre-check (15m) and then we'll run. If anyone needs to change timing ping here. Thanks :pray:
Diego (eng-ml): LGTM :+1:
Jin (eng-platform): Got it, will post image link when pushed.
bench-bot: Artifacts storage bucket created: s3://redwood-bench/halcyon-1769998888. Upload hook: http://bench-uploads.internal/hooks/1769998888
Claire (partnerships): Perfect — I'll follow up with Halcyon and loop back with any spec changes.
